promo.title: Get Dobie Dash on your iPhone
promo.text: Game Center leaderboards, haptics and your progress saved to iCloud.

currencies.title: What are biscuits and bones for?

items.name: Biscuits
items.text: Collected in every run. Spend them on collars, outfits and trails in the Wardrobe, or on Keep running? (50, then 100, then 200 in one run). You also get them from missions, your daily streak and chests.

items.name: Golden Bones
items.text: The rare one. Unlock new breeds (80 each) and the fanciest items, like the Crown, Super Cape and Rainbow trail. Found in chests and on day 7 of your streak.

items.name: Golden biscuits
items.text: Rare shiny biscuits in a run. Grab one for instant Zoomies: a speed boost that smashes through everything.

items.name: Reaching worlds
items.text: Some trails can't be bought. They unlock the first time you reach their world.

feedback.subject: Dobie Dash feedback
feedback.hint: Found a bug or have an idea? Tell Dan.

offline.store: You're offline. The Store needs a connection to show prices and buy. Your game and everything you own still work.
offline.league: You're offline. Leaderboards need a connection. Your runs still count and will show up next time you're online.
